output-shaft-into-base.calibration_note: The source sequence and collision-on trial inform only scene layout. The historical -40-unit rest offset and -52.5-degree phase are not physical success criteria; seat geometry and positive/negative evaluator calibration remain pending.

transfer-shaft-into-base.calibration_note: The source sequence and collision-on trial inform only scene layout. The historical -40-unit rest offset is not a physical success criterion; seat geometry and positive/negative evaluator calibration remain pending.

input-shaft-into-base.calibration_note: The source sequence and collision-on trial inform only scene layout. The Input Shaft collision mesh is not watertight; its density-derived mass is an explicitly provisional assumption. The historical -40-unit rest offset and 88.5-degree phase are not physical success criteria.

m10-casing-bolt.fixture_clearance_note: Elevated static fixture leaves clearance for the approximately 110mm under-head shank below the casing; table-top mounting obstructed full insertion. Not a target pose or scoring tolerance.
m10-casing-bolt.calibration_note: One representative bolt bore is selected from public geometry at runtime. Candidate start orientation is only a scene reset hint; seating depth and positive/negative physical evaluator calibration are pending.

m10-casing-nut.calibration_note: The scene uses a separate static public bolt CAD fixture. Current authored bolt/nut collision meshes appear smooth and omit helical thread geometry; thread pitch, phase, engagement depth, torque criteria, and negative evaluator cases are therefore unverified. Do not count an axial push-fit as threaded completion.

casing-top-to-base.calibration_note: The top/base parting-plane relation, shaft clearances, dynamic mass, multi-point seating tolerances, and positive/negative physical tests are uncalibrated. The source transform is not used as success GT.

oil-level-indicator.calibration_note: One of two repeated indicator placements is represented. Its opening identity is selected from public observations; axis, seat, release, stability, and negative evaluator criteria require calibration.

breather-plug.calibration_note: The matching opening is selected from public observations. Fit, seat depth, release, stability, and negative evaluator criteria require calibration.

bearing-32013-onto-output-shaft.calibration_note: Top/bottom instances share this representative bearing/shaft relation. Bore axis is inferred from public mesh; seat, orientation and negative evaluator criteria are uncalibrated.

bearing-transfer-onto-shaft.calibration_note: Original sub_step_bearing_transfer and magic_assembly.py define the negative-X flat shoulder with the bearing wide +X face leading. Full CAD source-correspondence audit supports exposing shaft -X upward using +90deg Y fixture rotation. Earlier -90deg Y runs are opposite-end diagnostics only. Physical seating and negative evaluator calibration remain pending.

bearing-input-bottom-onto-shaft.calibration_note: Original sub_step_bearing_input_bottom maps bearing +X to shaft +Y: the -100.75 mm source offset plus the 16.25 mm wide face matches the negative-Y shoulder at -84.5 mm. The original fixture Rx(-90) already exposes shaft -Y upward; the correction is relative moving Rz(+90), making the wide +X face lead downward. Reset hints are not success GT. Input shaft collision geometry is open, so its mass profile remains provisional; physical seating and negative evaluator calibration remain pending.

bearing-input-top-onto-shaft.calibration_note: User confirmed location B on 2026-10-24: the input-shaft middle shoulder from sub_step_bearing_input_top, not the first exposed shaft-end shoulder. Fixture Rx(+90) exposes positive Y upward so source relative Rz(-90) makes bearing wide +X face lead downward onto the negative-Y-facing shoulder at Y=-17.5mm. Previous Rx(-90) exposes the wrong insertion end for B. Source root offset local Y +2.732481mm is a private candidate, not physical-success certification or actor coordinates. Input shaft collision geometry is open, so its mass profile is provisional; seat and negative evaluator criteria remain uncalibrated.
